ledger: Hand | resting on leftmost block | moving right, leaving a trail of blocks | continuous rightward motion until the end
Blocks | initially two blocks present | a row of ten blocks present | blocks continuously materialize from the moving hand

findings.description: As the hand moves to the right, new blocks continuously materialize on the table behind it. There is no physical source or container providing these blocks, making their spontaneous appearance an effect without a valid physical cause.
The hand instantaneously teleports from the far right end of the block row to the middle of the row, violating the principle of continuous motion within a single shot.
